mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 258.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and higher real interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 258.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and prompts aggressive monetary policy, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1600.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 525000.0) indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1600.0 and RSAFS > 525000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) with rising policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), aggressive monetary tightening reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 152000.0) signals sustained economic expansion and rising corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strong job growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong housing market regime (HOUST > 1600.0), elevated consumer confidence drives retail spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 108.0) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 19200.0) signal a deepening economic contraction, reducing corporate profitability and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 108.0 and GDPC1 < 19200.0.
